title: retry-history
description: The backward-looking record of a run's retries: one entry per retry actually taken, naming the attempt that failed, why it failed, where execution was routed, and where that attempt's artifacts were archived. It is not retry-guidance.json, which tells the next attempt what to fix, and it is not the attempts/ archive, which holds the evidence itself. The file exists only for runs that retried; a run that never retries produces no empty file and no empty array. The coordinator writes it and does not validate its own write at run time; conformance is checked by the story's tests. History is evidence, never state: no routing decision reads it. A self-route is deliberately not recorded here, and the omission is a decision rather than a gap: an entry describes a retry that was taken, and a self-route has no verdict behind it, no destination other than the stage that failed, and no attempts/attempt-N/ archive to name — three of this entry's four required fields would have nothing to hold. It spends neither retry_count nor max_retries, so a reader comparing this file against retry_count still finds them in agreement. What a self-route leaves instead is a self-route-result artifact and one self-routed entry in execution-history.json.

items.description: One retry that was taken. The guidance is optional because a retry can be routed without a verifier writing any — a clean-clone failure follows a passing verdict.

attempt.description: The 1-based attempt this entry describes: the one that just failed, matching the attempts/attempt-N/ directory and the rendered prompts of the same attempt.

blocking_issues.description: The blocking issues as the verifier recorded them in that attempt's verification-result.json, field for field rather than in summary. Empty when the verdict carried none.

severity.description: How badly the finding blocks acceptance.

location.description: File or area the finding applies to.

required_behavior.description: What must be true for the finding to clear.

retry_stage.description: The workflow stage execution was rerouted to, taken from the failing stage's on_failure block.

archive_directory.description: Run-directory-relative path of the attempts/attempt-N/ directory holding that attempt's archived artifacts.

guidance.description: The retry-guidance.json written for the following attempt, as it stood when the retry was routed. Absent when no guidance was written.

current_focus.description: The specific things the retry must fix.

preserve_behavior.description: Accepted behavior the retry must not change.

retry_scope.description: Files or areas the retry may modify.
